parameters.name: secret_arn

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) that specifies the resource to access. Format: ```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

Parameter description:

regionId: the region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html operation to obtain this value.
accountId: the Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html operation to obtain this value.
instanceId: the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
用于指向用户希望访问的资源，格式如下：```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

参数说明如下：

regionId：地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html接口获取。
accountId：阿里云账号ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html接口获取。
instanceId：实例ID
